ops.text: e. Client Ownership. Subject to the license granted in Section 8(d), as between the parties Client retains all right, title and interest in and to Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, and all borrower, loan and other data submitted by or on behalf of Client or its customers through the Interface or to the Web Site, and shall own all deliverables and work product prepared for Client under the Support Services, which TrueLink hereby assigns to Client. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to TrueLink, or creates any joint ownership of, any of the foregoing. To the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in such deliverables, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use such TrueLink Intellectual Property as part of those deliverables.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) preserves TrueLink's ownership of the Interface, which we accept, but nothing confirms that we keep our own content, intellectual property and borrower/loan data or that we own the deliverables and work product we pay for. We have added a reciprocal ownership subsection (subject to the existing Section 8(d) Credit Data licence) with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back for any embedded TrueLink IP.
proposal.summary: Add Client ownership of Client Content, Client IP and borrower data plus assignment of Support Services deliverables and work product, with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP and no joint ownership.
